name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Paid Media & Performance Strategist | Google Ads, Lead Quality, Client-Facing Reporting
summary: Marketing strategist with 15+ years across agency, MarTech, and SaaS, leading paid media and full-funnel performance strategy for portfolios of client accounts. Owns Google Ads accounts end to end at Solenzo and led integrated paid, inbound, and content strategy at Level Agency, where campaign reporting tracked ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs rather than platform vanity metrics. Built a decade of client-facing account work before that, so performance conversations land as recommendations clients act on. Currently building AI-driven marketing systems, with a working view of how platform automation is reshaping campaign structure and targeting.
